title: The Morning Digest: November 18, 2026
dek: Brent Jan27 settled $93.14, up $0.70 or 0.8 percent, and WTI Dec26 settled $86.01, up $0.29 or 0.3 percent on Tuesday (Reuters, Nov 17), and Asia gave the recovery back to Brent $92.53 and WTI $84.77 at 0550 GMT on Wednesday (Reuters, Nov 18), with WTI falling roughly twice as hard and the Brent to WTI spread widening from $7.13 toward a more than two-week high. The industry estimate for the week ending Nov 13 printed a crude build of 5.28 million barrels against a survey consensus of 1.0 million, ahead of today's official report. December WCS is -$28.22 (ICE TMW settle, Nov 17) on zero lots, a ninth straight session without a December trade, and no December apportionment notice had been published after Tuesday's nominations close. The validated diesel crack is $80.91 on the latest print.
